title: A person's mark on one item
description: What POST /api/v1/items/{key}/marks answers, and `ingestion items mark --json` prints. The body names the mark, low-quality or read, and a service's body also names the login of the person it marks for. A mark moves no item. Sent again with the mark the item holds from the same person, it answers that mark and appends none.

families.description: Each family's standing after the mark moved it, and empty where the mark agreed and disagreed with nothing.
